query: What signals suggest a goal will be highly achieved?

per_column.name: intervention_type
per_column.rationale: The kind of intervention (automation, training, cost restructuring, etc.) is a characteristic of the goal's approach knowable in advance and plausibly correlates with whether it will be highly achieved. Legitimate exogenous predictor.

per_column.name: action_specificity
per_column.rationale: Whether specific actions are named versus a general approach reflects planning quality, an antecedent trait that plausibly carries predictive signal about achievement. Does not restate or leak the outcome.

per_column.name: baseline_reference_present
per_column.rationale: Presence of a baseline reference is a plan-quality feature available before the outcome; measurable goals often perform differently. Valid predictor.

per_column.name: improvement_magnitude
per_column.rationale: The ambition of the targeted improvement (20% vs 25-30% vs <15%) is set at goal definition, outside the achievement outcome, and plausibly affects likelihood of high achievement. Legitimate predictor, though partially related to target_percentage.

per_column.name: time_horizon
per_column.rationale: Timeframe (quarter, fiscal year, multi-year) is known upfront and plausibly influences achievement odds. Exogenous predictor.

per_column.name: scope_breadth
per_column.rationale: Organizational scope (company-wide vs team-level) is a structural attribute set before outcome and can correlate with achievement. Valid predictor.

per_column.name: metric_category_alignment
per_column.rationale: Whether the stated action aligns with the metric being measured is a plan-coherence feature knowable in advance and plausibly predictive. Not a restatement of the outcome.

per_column.name: technology_enablement
per_column.rationale: Whether technology enables the goal is an approach attribute available upfront that may boost achievement. Legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: feedback_loop_present
per_column.rationale: Existence of a feedback/monitoring loop is a design feature knowable in advance and plausibly linked to higher achievement. Valid predictor.

judge.rationale: All nine added columns are exogenous, plan- and approach-level attributes of a goal that are knowable before the achievement outcome is realized; none restate high_goal_achievement or leak it via a component/deterministic function. As a set they capture distinct dimensions (intervention type, specificity, measurability, ambition, timeframe, scope, alignment, tech, feedback), giving a model meaningful predictive leverage beyond the original operational columns. Utility is strong but not maximal because several are derived from the same description field and some (e.g., improvement_magnitude) overlap with existing target_percentage, limiting independent signal.
